test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Himachal Pradesh Chief Minister has launched a 'Naari Ko Naman' scheme that will allow women passengers in the state to pay only ______ of the fare for their travel within the state.
solution:
The correct answer is **50%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Previous Himachal Pradesh CM Jai Ram Thakur on 30 June 2022 launched the 'Naari Ko Naman' scheme in Dharamshala.
 
• Under this scheme, the Himachal Road Transport Corporation (HRTC) will charge women travelers only half**(****50%)** the fare for their travel within the state.
 
• Seema Thakur, the first woman bus driver in the state, drove the CM in a state transport bus to the event venue.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• ​Himachal Pradesh is a northern Indian state in the Himalayas.
 
• It's home to scenic mountain towns and resorts such as Dalhousie.
 
• The region is also well known for its trekking, climbing and skiing areas.

• Chief Minister (Current) : Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu
 
• Capitals: Shimla (Summer), Dharamshala (Winter)
